# Plugin Architecture — claude-kit

## Plugin Categories

Three categories exist. Each has different structural rules and loading behavior.

### 1. Core Plugins (`core-*`)

Knowledge plugins that provide reference context for AI agents.

- `"role": "knowledge"` in `ctl.json` (exceptions: `core-kit`, `core-spec`, and
  `core-ai` have `"role": "system"`)
- Must have a `"domain"` field in `ctl.json`
- **Must NOT contain `agents/` or `commands/` directories** — skills and hooks only
- Auto-loaded based on domain matching:
  - `"domain": "universal"` — loads for every active session
  - `"domain": "<specific>"` — loads only when that domain is active

Current core plugins: `core-kit`, `core-spec`, `core-ai`.

### 2. Team Plugins (`<team>-<role>`)

Five-role architecture per team. Each team has exactly these roles:

| Role | Has agents/commands? | Has skills? | ctl.json role value |
|------|---------------------|-------------|---------------------|
| engineer | Yes | Yes | `"engineer"` |
| grader | Yes | Yes | `"grader"` |
| tester | Yes | Yes | `"tester"` |
| debugger | Yes | Yes | `"debugger"` |
| knowledge | No | Yes | `"knowledge"` |

The knowledge role within a team behaves like a core plugin — skills only, no
agents or commands. Current teams and their domain values:

| Team prefix | Domain |
|-------------|--------|
| `embedded-zephyr-` | `"embedded"` |
| `cloud-python-` | `"backend"` |
| `frontend-svelte-` | `"frontend"` |

### 3. System Plugins (`system-*`)

Utility plugins that provide workflow orchestration tools.

- `"role": "system"` in `ctl.json`
- Not domain-specific — loaded explicitly, never auto-loaded
- Contain agents and commands for plugin creation and maintenance workflows
- Current system plugins: `system-maker`, `system-updater`

## The `ctl.json` File

Lives at `.claude-plugin/ctl.json` alongside `plugin.json`. Controls loading
behavior and dependency wiring.

```json
{
  "role": "engineer",
  "domain": "embedded",
  "companions": ["embedded-zephyr-knowledge", "core-kit"]
}
```

| Field | Values | Purpose |
|-------|--------|---------|
| `role` | `knowledge`, `system`, `engineer`, `grader`, `tester`, `debugger` | Determines directory structure rules and UI treatment |
| `domain` | `"universal"`, `"embedded"`, `"backend"`, `"frontend"`, etc. | Controls auto-loading scope |
| `companions` | Array of plugin directory names | Declares skill dependencies for cross-reference resolution |

**All companion names in `companions[]` must exist as directories under
`plugins/` before committing.** The validator enforces this.

## Auto-Loading Logic

When a team plugin is loaded via `--kit`, core plugins are auto-loaded alongside
it using this rule:

1. Core plugins with `"domain": "universal"` always load
2. Core plugins with a domain matching the team's domain also load
3. No other plugins are auto-loaded

Example: `claude-kit --kit embedded-zephyr-engineer` loads:
- `embedded-zephyr-engineer` (requested)
- `core-kit` (universal)
- `core-spec` (universal)
- Any core plugin with `"domain": "embedded"`

## Companion Skill References

Agents reference skills from companion plugins using the prefix syntax:

```
companion-name:skill-name
```

Example in an agent's `skills:` list:

```yaml
skills:
  - embedded-zephyr-knowledge:zephyr-rtos
  - core-kit:routing
```

The companion must be declared in `ctl.json` → `companions[]` for this to
resolve correctly.

## Plugin Directory Structure

```
plugins/<name>/
  .claude-plugin/
    plugin.json     # name, description, version (only these three fields)
    ctl.json        # role, domain, companions
  agents/           # <agent-name>.md — role plugins only
  commands/         # <command-name>.md — role plugins only
  skills/
    <skill-name>/
      SKILL.md      # skill frontmatter + content
  hooks/
    hooks.json      # hook event bindings
  scripts/          # bash scripts called by hooks
  README.md         # human-readable documentation
```

## Loading a Plugin

```bash
claude-kit --kit <plugin-name>    # full flag
claude-kit -k <plugin-name>       # short flag
```

For multiple plugins in one session, use multiple `--kit` flags or configure
companions in `ctl.json` for automatic co-loading.

## Project Root Structure

```
claude-kit                  # single-file Python CLI (no .py extension)
install.sh                  # curl-based installer for end users
CHANGELOG.md                # release history (Unreleased → versioned sections)
ROADMAP.md                  # shipped releases + planned work
README.md                   # repo-level documentation
pyproject.toml              # root package definition (stdlib-only)

claude_kit/                 # Python library package (stdlib-only)
  __init__.py               # public API exports
  models.py                 # Plugin, Session, TelemetryEvent dataclasses
  telemetry.py              # TelemetryEmitter + event emission
  api_client.py             # lightweight HTTP client for telemetry API
  resolver.py               # PluginResolver (find, expand, companions)
  session.py                # SessionManager (prepare, finalize)
  encryption.py             # PluginDecryptor + TempDirManager
  version.py                # VersionManager (current, remote)
  exceptions.py             # PluginNotFoundError, DecryptionError, etc.

plugins/                    # all plugins — core, team, and system
  core-*/                   # knowledge + system plugins
  <team>-<role>/            # team plugins (5 roles per team)
  system-*/                 # workflow orchestration plugins

scripts/                    # CI, validation, and build tooling
  validate-plugins.py       # Tier 1 structural validation
  test-cli.sh               # CLI smoke tests
  test-plugin-consistency.sh # cross-reference and frontmatter checks
  encrypt-plugins.sh        # AES-256-CBC encryption for distribution
  build-semantic-prompt.py  # PR semantic review prompt builder
  build-nightly-prompt.py   # nightly review + PR body builder
  build-autofix-prompt.py   # CI failure auto-fix prompt builder

docs/                       # design documents and research
  research/                 # theoretical research (not operational)
  theory-context-cache.md   # context cache architecture theory

templates/                  # file templates for plugin scaffolding
  agent.md.tmpl             # agent frontmatter + structure
  command.md.tmpl           # command frontmatter + structure
  hooks.json.tmpl           # hook event bindings template
  plugin.json.tmpl          # plugin.json scaffold
  skill.md.tmpl             # skill frontmatter + structure

local/                      # user-mode runtime directory (not committed)
  plugins/                  # decrypted plugin cache
  backups/                  # pre-update backup snapshots
  setup-manifest.json       # tracks installed plugin state

api/                        # FastAPI telemetry + auth service
  app/                      # application package
    auth/                   # JWT, API keys, OAuth models + endpoints
    telemetry/              # event ingestion, queries, aggregation
    models/                 # SQLAlchemy base
    middleware/             # request ID, logging
  tests/                    # pytest-asyncio test suite (SQLite in-memory)
  migrations/               # Alembic migration scaffold
  Dockerfile                # multi-stage Python 3.12 image
  docker-compose.yml        # local dev with PostgreSQL
  pyproject.toml            # deps, pytest config, ruff config

test/                       # test fixtures, scenarios, and library unit tests
  test_parity.py            # CLI/library parity enforcement tests
  test_telemetry.py         # TelemetryEmitter + TelemetryEvent tests
  test_api_client.py        # APIClient HTTP transport tests
  test_resolver.py          # PluginResolver tests
  test_session.py           # SessionManager tests
  test_encryption.py        # PluginDecryptor + TempDirManager tests
  test_version.py           # VersionManager tests
  engine/                   # unified execution layer
    config.py               # EvalScenario, RunConfig, RunResult, BenchmarkResult
    executor.py             # ConversationExecutor (API conversation driver)
    human.py                # HumanSimulator (Claude-backed human stand-in)
    session_factory.py      # wraps claude_kit library for benchmark use
  scoring/                  # scoring pipeline
    base.py                 # Scorer protocol + ScoringResult
    deterministic.py        # Contains, NoError, TelemetrySchema, TokenEfficiency
    llm_judge.py            # LLM-as-Judge (individual + pairwise)
    rubric.py               # Rubric definitions (YAML-loadable)
    statistical.py          # Bootstrap CI, paired tests (stdlib only)
  benchmark/                # orchestration + reporting
    runner.py               # BenchmarkRunner (wires executor + scorers)
    comparator.py           # PairwiseComparator (kit vs raw)
    report.py               # JSON + markdown report generation
    __main__.py             # CLI entry point for running benchmarks
  scenarios/                # test input scenarios (YAML format)
    benchmarks/             # benchmark scenario definitions
  results/                  # test output artifacts

.devcontainer/              # developer environment (not for end users)
.github/workflows/          # CI/CD pipeline (7 workflows)
.claude/                    # AI agent configuration (rules, commands, hooks)
```

The `local/` directory is created at runtime by `claude-kit update` and should
not be committed. The `templates/` directory is used by `system-maker` when
scaffolding new plugins.
